entities.name: 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Primary authentication procedure initiated by the network using 5G AKA method. It establishes authentication and key agreement between UE and network.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to initiate 5G AKA authentication procedure. Contains authentication parameters and security context identifiers.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: UE response message to AUTHENTICATION REQUEST, containing authentication calculation results.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network when authentication fails, terminating the authentication procedure.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Timer started by network when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST, waiting for UE response.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier used by UE and AMF to identify K_AMF and partial native security context created after successful authentication.

entities.name: ABBA parameter
entities.description: Authentication and key management for applications parameter. In this specification release, set to 2 octets with value 0000H.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: 5GMM connection state where UE has an established NAS signaling connection with the network.

entities.name: Initial NAS message condition
entities.description: Condition where ngKSI is contained in an initial NAS message during a 5GMM procedure, requiring different ngKSI value in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

relations.description: Authentication procedure is initiated by sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
Network starts timer T3560 when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
Timer T3560 is stopped when AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE is received
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains ngKSI information element
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains ABBA parameter
Authentication procedure can be initiated when UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
When ngKSI is in initial NAS message, different ngKSI value must be used in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message terminates the authentication procedure when authentication fails
